legend.0: Nothing happens: it is an idea, a wish or something optional.
legend.1: A small inconvenience for the person, e.g. a chore at home takes longer.
legend.2: It hurts work or studies, e.g. a lower grade or a colleague kept waiting.
legend.3: Serious harm, e.g. a failed course, a missed payment or appointment, or a legal or health problem.
